item.title: 'Night turned into day': Iranians tell of strikes on oil depots
item.summary: Fuel depots were hit in Tehran and Karaj overnight, with videos showing huge fires and plumes of smoke in multiple locations.

item.title: In maps: Nine days of strikes across the Middle East
item.summary: Israel has continued strikes across Iran and Lebanon and the Iranian regime has carried out more attacks, as the war continues for a ninth day.

item.title: 'Mind boggles' at doubts over legality of Iran war, Israeli president says
item.summary: Isaac Herzog says Israel is acting out of "self-defence" on behalf of Israel, the wider region and Europe.

item.title: Watch: 'This is a moment of grave peril', says UN humanitarian chief
item.summary: UN Humanitarian Affairs Lead Tom Fletcher speaks to the BBC about the conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Grok posts on Hillsborough and Munich disasters are 'sickening', government says
item.summary: Premier League sides Liverpool and Manchester United have both complained to Elon Musk's social media platform X about the posts, some of which have now been removed.

item.title: Starmer and Trump speak for first time since president's Iran criticism
item.summary: The phone call comes after a week in which Donald Trump repeatedly expressed frustration at Keir Starmer's stance on Iran.

item.title: Police separate Celtic and Rangers fans after Ibrox pitch invasion
item.summary: Flares were thrown as supporters from both sides spilled onto the pitch after Celtic's 4-2 win on penalties.

item.title: The heartwarming tale of a father, a daughter, and a wedding band wowing India
item.summary: Band Baaja Bitiya is the moving tale of a father who goes to rescue his daughter from her matrimonial home.

item.title: UK opens charter flights booking portal for Britons in Dubai
item.summary: It comes after thousands of flights had been cancelled in the Middle East in the past week.

item.title: Explosion at US embassy in Oslo may have been terrorism, Norway police say
item.summary: Police say they are investigating other motives after the blast caused minor damage to the embassy building.
